title: Ennore Creek oil spill during Cyclone Michaung flooding
subRegion: Ennore Creek / Kosasthalaiyar river to Kasimedu harbour, north Chennai

incident.timeNote: Oil released with flood water on 4-5 December 2023
incident.positionSource: Ennore Creek mouth (approximate); reported extent from Kasimedu harbour to Kosasthalaiyar river

oil.spilledNote: Release quantity not published. Recovered: 105.82 kL oily water and 393.5 t oily sludge.

facilities.name: CPCL MANALI REFINERY (STORM OUTLET)
facilities.note: TNPCB found stagnant storm water with oil near CPCL storm outlet; CPCL disputed sole responsibility

observations.description: Oil spread over ~20 sq km from Kasimedu harbour to Kosasthalaiyar river

timeline.event: Cyclone Michaung heavy rainfall over Chennai (3-4 Dec)
Oil-mixed flood water enters Kosasthalaiyar river, Ennore Creek and sea
Rs 8.68 crore relief package announced for affected families

officialFindings: TNPCB attributed oil to storm water near CPCL's outlet; land-based source, not a vessel.

sources.title: Oil spill in Ennore brings fishing to a standstill (Mongabay India)
Emergency oil spill recovery work in Ennore completed (Deccan Herald)
